source.scope: Exact isolated candidate only. Later shared feature/evidence commits are not compiled or adopted by this result.

native.launch: Actual nice -n19 pinned Python -I -B wrapper launch; wrapper sets exact child cwd/argv. Actual Go process record corroborates pinned executable, six-key env and nice19.
native.provenance_limit: Retained surfaced actual tool argument/result objects corroborate the attempt; they are not independent harness-backend or OS syscall audit logs.

controls.resource_limit: Measured RSS retained; memory/cache/scratch estimates are not enforced caps.
controls.single_attempt_evidence: Exclusive qa-output creation, one started PID, one retained native compile session with five polls and one terminal receipt; no retry path.

It was not filtered or relabeled. The complete source, pinned tools, request and effective Go child environment match before/after/current, so this does not change exact compile acceptance.

helper_observation.limit: Review does not grant a general host-cleanliness or unrelated tool-installation guarantee.

release_observation.limit: Read-only named process absence and proc-lock inspection are point-in-time observations. Historical running proof also retained an empty matching proc-lock view; held-lock execution is supported by the inspected wrapper path rather than an asserted OS lock trace. No comprehensive descendant or unrelated-job inventory.

limits: Acceptance is one exact candidate compile/link with default vet. No target init, TestMain, test body or produced binary was executed by the true-c compile; inspected wrapper has no binary-execution path.
Historical cc37 selected-root runtime stays bound to cc37. No new runtime rerun, direct-call trace, full-suite/race/live/cloud/native production qualification.
No later shared-feature compile credit, source adoption, canonical retirement, count change or global completion credit.
Original SOURCE_ONLY seal is preserved historical preparation evidence; output receipt and native manifests separately attest the subsequent compile.

No reviewer Go/build/test/discovery/runner/native polling/binary execution, lock/lease/grant, source/index edit, Git mutation, push, publication or cloud access. Only this fresh exclusive review artifact is written.
